text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's just a teensy little injury! It's no big
deal!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: ならまだ頑張ってみよう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's keep trying a bit longer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, I bet my mom would be
totally fine
with it, as long as I go easy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I know that! I'm just saying, it's not
such a
big deal!
choice_data_list: 俺は君のママじゃないから
私は貴方のママじゃないから
choice_data_list_en: I'm not your mom, you know.
I'm not your mom, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After tending to her injury, I tell Teio to
take the
rest of the day off, just to play
it safe.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okie-dokie! Then, let's get this star―

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Urgh. I said I'm fine! Could you hurry
up and go
get ready?
choice_data_list_en: It really does hurt, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely not going to happen. I
tell her to
take the rest of the day off.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Then let's get right back to it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna put on an even better show
than usual!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After tending to her injury, I let Teio
start training
again.
